poc_plan_summary: Environment: small Dedicated GPU pool (reserved), VPC peering to customer network.
Traffic pattern: start with Hosted API for baseline, then mirror 10% traffic to Dedicated canary node. Increase to 50% if P50/P95 and quality pass. Final cutover optional.
Canary config: blue/green with traffic split; metrics gating on P95 latency, token cost delta, end-to-end intent accuracy (>95% pass rate on eval set).

Fallback routing: implement per-route policy — primary high-quality model, fallback to quantized variant; region failover policy us-east -> eu-west automated on node failure or latency spike > 2x baseline.
Rollback: automated rollback on canary fail conditions + manual abort path. Runbook to include postmortem template and data-sanitization steps.
Evaluation datasets: in-house prompts (500 examples), live-sampled low-traffic shadow set, and reranking benchmark (NDCG).
Success criteria: meet latency and accuracy targets, acceptable cost reduction vs hosted baseline, seamless SSO auth and audit log collection in Dedicated environment.
technical_requirements: P95 latency target: <= 300ms for chat flows at typical seq lengths.
Throughput: support 50 qps with burst capacity to 120 qps.
Routing: per-route model policy + region failover + automatic fallback to smaller model on capacity pressure.
Observability: need token-level cost breakdown, per-request trace id mapping to internal ticket ids, exportable logs to customer SIEM.
Security: SAML SSO, KMS integration, audit log retention 12 months, ability to pin model versions for compliance.
